MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the Admit Card for the post of Sub Inspector SI & Subedar. This recruitment has been issued for 507 posts. The online application process for MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Correction 2026 were accepted from 24 September 2026, to 28 September 2026. The Examination is going to conducted from 28 October 2026. Candidates must download their MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Admit Card 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 September 2026
  • Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 September 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 28 September 2026
  • Exam Date : 28 October 2026
  • Admit Card : 25 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 310/-
  • Portal Charges Extra Include

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card
  • Online Correction Form
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Admit Card 2026?

MPESB MP Police SI, Subedar Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
